message.content:
This is a woven fabric of synthetic filament yarns, which falls in heading 5407. Because it is made wholly of textured polyester filament yarns, it belongs in 5407.54 or 5407.61 and neighboring subheadings.

Subheading 5407.61 covers fabrics containing 85 percent or more by weight of non-textured polyester filaments. This fabric uses textured yarns, so 5407.61 does not apply.

Subheading 5407.5x covers dyed fabrics. Because the fabric is made of yarns of different colors, it falls under 5407.52 (dyed), 5407.53 (yarns of different colors), or 5407.54 (printed). The yarns-of-different-colors subheading is 5407.53, which is for synthetic filament woven fabrics containing 85 percent or more textured polyester filaments, so I'm not certain of its exact scope.

The actual structure is: 5407.51 unbleached or bleached; 5407.52 dyed; 5407.53 of yarns of different colors; 5407.54 printed. These are under 5407.5, which covers other woven fabrics containing 85 percent or more by weight of textured polyester filaments. So 5407.53 applies.

Subheading 5407.53 has statistical suffixes of 5407.53.2000 (jacquard) and 5407.53.2000 vs 5407.53.9000. I recall 5407.53.20 being "Other" with 5407.53.2000 as the 10-digit code in the HTS, and I believe the 5407.53.10 line covers fabrics with a "plain weave" and 5407.53.20 covers "Other."

Because the fabric is other than plain, satin, or twill weave, the "Other" line is the match. I'm settling on 5407.53.2000, though the exact suffix is from memory.

{"hts_code": "5407.53.2000", "reason": "Woven fabric of 85%+ textured polyester filament yarns of different colors, other than plain, satin or twill weave, falls under heading 5407, subheading 5407.53."}
